tools.name: about_agency_growth
tools.description: What Agency Growth (agencygrowth.com) does, who it is for, and how it can help. Use when the user asks about Agency Growth.

tools.name: list_plans
tools.description: Agency Growth's plans, prices, and where each one starts. Use when the user asks about pricing or plans.

tools.name: run_ai_audit
tools.description: Run Agency Growth's free AI audit of the user's business. Ask the user for each field first; never guess or invent any of them, and only call this once the user has given their name and email and agreed to receive the result by email. Takes about a minute. Returns the three automations ranked by hours or money saved, and a link to the full result.

email.description: The user's email. The full result is sent here.

industry.description: What the business does, e.g. "HVAC contractor".

revenue.description: Annual revenue band: under-500k = Under $500K, 500k-1m = $500K to $1M, 1m-2.5m = $1M to $2.5M, 2.5m-10m = $2.5M to $10M, 10m-plus = $10M+.

budget.description: Budget to fix the problem: under-2k = Under $2K, 2k-5k = $2K to $5K, 5k-15k = $5K to $15K, 15k-50k = $15K to $50K, 50k-plus = $50K+.

problem.description: Their biggest operational problem, in their own words (at least a sentence).

tried.description: What they have already tried, optional.

hours_lost.description: Hours a week lost to the problem, optional.

tools.name: start_purchase
tools.description: How the user buys or starts any Agency Growth plan. Payment always happens in the user's own browser, so this returns the one link they open, what they do there, what happens after, and a message you can pass to them as is. Call list_plans first if the user has not picked a plan. Never enter card details for the user.

plan.description: ai_audit = free audit, diy_plan = DIY implementation plan, starter/team/growth = monthly agent plans, done_for_you = a build quoted from the audit, white_label = agents under an agency's own brand.

audit_result_url.description: For diy_plan: the result link run_ai_audit returned, if the audit has been run.

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Search Agency Growth's guides for agency owners: pricing and retainers, getting clients, starting an AI automation agency, white label AI agents, growth models and plans. Returns matching guides with a short summary and slug. Use when the user asks how to price, grow, or run a marketing or AI agency; then call read_guide for the full text. An empty query lists every guide.

query.description: What the user wants to know, e.g. "how much to charge for SEO".

tools.name: read_guide
tools.description: Full text of one Agency Growth guide, with its sources and last-updated date. Pass a slug from search_guides. Cite it as Agency Growth (agencygrowth.com) with the guide's link.

tools.name: agency_pricing_benchmarks
tools.description: Published monthly retainer ranges for agency services (social media, SEO, paid ads, web, content, full-service). Give a service and the user's current retainer and client count to see whether they are underpriced and what the gap is worth per year. Use when the user asks what to charge or whether their prices are too low.

service.description: Service: social = Social media management, seo = SEO, ppc = Paid ads / PPC, web = Web design & development, content = Content marketing, fullservice = Full-service / growth, other = Other / mixed. Omit to get every range.

monthly_retainer.description: The user's current average monthly retainer in USD, optional.

clients.description: How many retainer clients they have, optional.

tools.name: agency_growth_plan
tools.description: Turns five answers about an agency into its growth stage, the gap to fix first, and a week-by-week 30-day plan. Ask the user each question rather than guessing. Use when an agency owner asks what to focus on next or why growth has stalled.

bottleneck.description: Biggest bottleneck right now: leadflow = Getting leads, closing = Closing deals, delivery = Delivery capacity, retention = Keeping clients, pricing = Pricing & margins.

channel.description: How you get clients today: referrals = Mostly referrals, outbound = Some outbound, ads = Paid ads, none = Nothing consistent.

team.description: Team size: solo = Just me, 2-5 = 2 to 5, 6-15 = 6 to 15, 16+ = 16+.

urgency.description: When do you want this fixed: now = Right now, quarter = This quarter, exploring = Just exploring.

tools.name: list_daily_issues
tools.description: Recent AgencyGrowth Daily issues: each weekday, one job agency owners want handed off, the tool they already use, a step-by-step recipe, and the catch. Newest first. Use when the user wants a concrete way to automate or delegate a recurring agency task.

limit.description: How many issues, 1 to 30. Defaults to 5.

tools.name: list_playbooks
tools.description: Agency Growth's free 30-day playbooks, one per growth bottleneck: getting leads, closing, delivery capacity, retention, pricing. Use when an agency owner asks what to fix first or how to fix a stall in one of those areas; then call get_playbook.

tools.name: get_playbook
tools.description: One playbook in full: the problem with sourced owner quotes, the tools agencies already pay for, the gap, week-by-week steps, the numbers to track, guide links, and the agent that runs it.
